editorialAdditions.scope: Only explicit intermediate labeling and nonexecution reason were added; all measurements and classifications unchanged

methodology.scope: Core API in instrumented immutable bundles; full CLI startup excluded.
methodology.order: Sequential baseline then current per scenario; fresh worker/setup per endpoint; repeated samples reuse process/fixture and accumulate transaction history.
methodology.cache: Warm filesystem after setup, without OS cache eviction. First process invocation is not cold OS cache.
methodology.samples: V3 has3 repeated observations for common operations; init/first activation/recovery interruption have1. V4 has1 throughout: singleObservationMs, median/dispersion/p95=null. p95 requires20 observations.
methodology.gitCount: Exact direct Core Git spawn invocations with PID, separated from failed attempts. Official cmd/git.exe launcher descendants are not observed.
methodology.bytes: Only logical materialized/withdrawn file bytes. Physical IO and page-cache traffic not measured.
methodology.memory: Worker RSS every10ms plus start/end; child Git RSS and shorter peaks not measured.
methodology.disk: 4GiB design budget, not a monitored quota. Final logical-size sum is not disk allocation or disk peak.
methodology.phaseTimings: Inclusive/nested method durations, not additive exclusive decomposition.
methodology.classification: n3 lower/higher only when observed ranges do not overlap, without exclusive causal attribution. n1 changes remain single observations and do not establish a distribution.
methodology.securityOracle: Final HEAD/symref/semantic MAIN index and original blobs; off absences; B/C plus repeated recovery refs in1L10. Preview registry/workspace/exclude. Functional suites separately verify full ownership/private indices/backups/modes.
methodology.multiLayerScale: 100 files TOTAL across2/5/10Layers; off/on bench0 moves50/20/10 files with otherLayers active. Not a pure Layer-count curve.
limitations: Fixed before/after order; cache/background/thermal variation not fully controlled, despite quiet timing window.
Large temporal dispersion remains visible in raw durations, min/max/MAD.
Only representative scale coverage, not a Cartesian matrix.
Protection opt-in disabled in timing fixtures.
No Linux or actual power-loss validation.
The interrupted V3 baseline32MiB is retained as supplementary incomplete evidence, never merged into V4.

interruption.auditLimitation: Inline stop helper signalled through held Process handles after immediate CIM command/creation identity checks, then persistence failed converting its Generic List of actions (ArgumentException). Its complete action list was not persisted. This recovered receipt does not reconstruct missing action records or claim all OS descendant closure.

partialInspection.scope: Read-only after20min endpoint timeout (setup/init included); interrupted activation Git entries were not flushed and are UNKNOWN
notes: A partial materialization is not an activatedLayer success.
Counts and logical file sizes are observations, not verification of backup validity or physicalIO.
Files, locks, journals, incomplete writes and backups were preserved; no ownership reassignment or recovery was attempted.
Endpoint budget includes fixture setup/init;20min is not activation latency.
Only completed init sample has durable exact directGit counts; in-memory entries from interrupted activation are unavailable.
Extensionless coordinator lock directory and owner metadata are preserved.
